Package com.jasonwjones.pbcs.client

Interface PbcsSubstitutionVariable

All Superinterfaces:
PbcsObject
All Known Subinterfaces:
PbcsApplicationSubstitutionVariable, PbcsPlanTypeSubstitutionVariable
All Known Implementing Classes:
PbcsApplicationSubstitutionVariableImpl, PbcsPlanTypeSubstitutionVariableImpl
public interface PbcsSubstitutionVariable extends PbcsObject
A substitution variable: a named value that business rules, forms and reports can refer to (as &CurYear, for example) in place of a hard-coded member.

Every variable has a name and a value, and is defined at a scope. EPM Cloud keeps variables for a whole application and for a single plan type, so every variable this library returns is at least a PbcsApplicationSubstitutionVariable, and a plan type's variables are PbcsPlanTypeSubstitutionVariables. Check getScope() and cast to the narrower type for its plan type. This type itself doesn't assume an application, which leaves room for a server scope: on-premises Essbase has one, and EPM Cloud's REST API doesn't expose it.

Instances are immutable snapshots of the server's values. To change a variable, pass a copy from withValue(String) to PbcsApplication.updateVariables(java.util.Collection), or use PbcsApplication.updateVariable(String, String) or PbcsPlanType.updateVariable(String, String).

Since:
3.1.0
